notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: A small update that fixed some bugs. In addition, I've removed the shaking when attacking and throwing pots! I remind you that ChildStory 2 is currently being actively developed. I would be pleased if you could add it to your wish list: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084690/Death_itself/?l=english

notes.title: Hotfix (27.04.24)
notes.notes:
Hi!
Thank you for your patience! I had a lot of work this month :)
I fixed the bugs that crashed the game and returned the old controls, without the mouse, as it spoiled the very atmosphere that I wanted to convey, as well as broke the complexity of the game!
Translation fixes, rebalancing and new endings are ahead!

notes.title: [Devlog. Day 919. 11 days after the release]
Devlog. 913 day. 5 days after the release
notes.notes:
[b][Devlog. 913 day. 5 days after the release][/b]
I delayed the update a bit in order to do a lot of work not only with the bugs that you promptly throw off to me, but also to improve other major aspects of the game.
1) The location of Masha's house has been changed. Added additional locations behind her house.
2) Fixed (one more) bug with music volume in cutscenes.
3) Fixed bugs with triggers in Shironiva.
4) Added saves in some difficult moments.
5) Reduced the number of enemies and their difficulty in some difficult locations.
6) Many little bugs that I find while watching your videos and broadcasts have been improved (thanks a lot)

notes.title: [Devlog. Day 910. 2 days after the release]
notes.notes:
[Devlog. Day 910. 2 days after the release]
🌚 I rolled out another hot fix that will probably break many saves! 🌚
Once again, I want to thank those who actively write to me about bugs in the game. I work tirelessly!
—List of changes from 21.01.24:
1) Fixed a bug that caused purchased items to become visually available for purchase after re-entering the game. Now the "Sold" sign will always remain!
2) Added sounds to the hook-cat (you asked for it very much);
3) Fixed bugs related to cutscenes that break the game.
4) Fixed visual bugs and some errors in the text!
5) Fixed a bug that caused Sonya to break the game by breaking the pot she was holding in her hands;
6) Fixed a bug that caused the music volume to drop by 50 percent after saving;
6) Numerous other minor bugs have been fixed, which nevertheless had a great impact on the overall impression.
---
This probably won't be the last hotfix I'll be pumping out in the near future, but I really appreciate your patience!
For me, as a developer, this is the most important thing right now!
Like ChildStory walkthroughs on YouTube, tell your friends about the game, play! It's very important now to talk about Sonya. Thanks! ✨

notes.title: The first update!
notes.notes:
[Devblog. Day 897]
Changing the balance and adding combos to the fight.
Now, if you press the interaction button after the blow, then a second sword strike will be performed, after which the usual blow will already be executed from the cannon. This combination is quite a bit more powerful than the usual clicking, but much more pleasant, while, it seems, it does not break the game. So I'm trying to make the combat system much more enjoyable and interesting.:>
Let's see how it looks from the outside!
